title: Finishing the twin - GLLVM.jl + gllvmTMB
mission: Finish the R-Julia twin: GLLVM.jl as the Julia engine and gllvmTMB as the R user surface. A capability is done only when engine support, R bridge support, point estimates, objective/logLik, CI or CI-status, docs/articles, visual evidence, tests, issue ledger, and Rose audit agree.
current_work: Phase 4 runtime gap fill is green locally on GLLVM.jl-integration: #91 high-rate Poisson divergence fixed, Gamma now defaults to analytic gradients after finite-vs-analytic benchmark gates, #92 phylo-signal Wald CI scale fix is wired into the main suite, full Pkg.test passed at 3869/1 broken, and Vitepress hard dead-links are fixed in a no-deploy docs build. Rose status-drift cleanup is now committed on integration. gllvmTMB live julia-bridge tests pass 53/53 and the R-side NEWS/check-log now match that evidence. Next gates are PR/issue reconciliation, canonical R bridge parity, missingness bridge, and structural speedups.
